evals.prompt: Storyboard scene 3 from my shot records.
evals.expected_output: Panel records per shot (two for moves/reveals) with composition on a thirds grid, arrow notation, durations, and the built HTML sheet.
expectations: Every shot has at least one 'record: panel' block with an ID like SB-SC03-SH010-P1
Shots with camera moves have start and end panels
Compositions state positions on the thirds grid and foreground/background
The build_storyboard.py script is run and the HTML file is produced or the reason it was not is stated

evals.prompt: Make the storyboard more exciting — add a shot of the villain watching from the roof.
evals.expected_output: Declines to add a story event, explains it belongs to the director/screenwriter, offers to raise a proposal.
expectations: No new villain shot is added to the storyboard
The response explains storyboard panels render approved shots only
A proposal to the film-director or screenwriter is offered

evals.prompt: Give me sketch prompts for each panel of scene 1 in rough storyboard style.
evals.expected_output: One consistent rough-sketch prompt per panel including the composition description and aspect ratio.
expectations: Each panel has a sketch prompt
All prompts share the same storyboard style wording
Each prompt includes the panel's composition and the aspect ratio
